queries.query: 平顶山市 不动产登记中心 地籍图 天地图 平顶山 自然资源和规划局
queries.scope: Confirm city-local registration office and find an anonymous public cadastral vector map.
queries.result: The Pingdingshan Natural Resources and Planning Bureau maintains a current real-property registration service section. Its 2026 guide identifies the municipal Real Estate Registration Center, requires applicant documentation for registration, and routes online service through a service portal. The bureau also links Tianditu Pingdingshan, while its basic-survey plan describes public geospatial map services and 1:1000 base mapping, not parcel polygons. No anonymous parcel-vector endpoint was identified.
